Dealers gain \\u0060DocFee\\u0060 and \\u0060AddOnsNote\\u0060. A \\u0060PostingAttributes\\u0060 table has a unique index on \\u0060(PostingId, Name)\\u0060. \\u0060LedgerUpsertService.SetPostingAttributesAsync(postingId, attributes, run, ct)\\u0060 replaces a name\\u0027s value and run and leaves unread names alone. \\u0060DealerGradeCommand.NeedsCheck(dealer, refresh)\\u0060 decides who gets looked up, and \\u0060CarEdgeGradeResult.DocFeeAmount\\u0060 parses the fee. The rule for typed column versus attribute is in \\u0060docs/ledger.md\\u0060.\\n- **Gotchas:** \\u0060UpsertAsync\\u0060 does not touch the new posting columns, unlike \\u0060ShippingFee\\u0060, which it overwrites from the candidate every time. The follow-ups must write them (and the attributes) themselves, and decide whether the latest sighting replaces them the way shipping fee does. \\u0060SetPostingAttributesAsync\\u0060 needs a saved \\u0060RunEntity\\u0060 and an existing posting id; a missing posting throws on the foreign key. Parse dollar strings by trimming \\u0060$\\u0060 and using \\u0060NumberStyles.AllowThousands\\u0060, because \\u0060NumberStyles.Currency\\u0060 with the invariant culture silently fails (recorded as lesson \\u0060fe9cbece\\u0060).\\n- **Left undone on purpose:**\\n  - Rank does not read any of this; that was ruled out for this task.\\n  - The walk does not read fees or badges off the pages yet; dealers, because they run before any fee can exist.\\n  - The run skill file in the project home is untouched, as instructed.\\n  - The \\u0060docs/\\u0060 walk page does not mention Carvana pickup,
